definitions.record: Original catalog identity; source copies can be multiple records for one physical market.
definitions.supported: A configured, enabled reader recognizes this record source URL and required identity/geography; not proof of successful read, all fields extracted or current opening.
definitions.unsupported: No currently admitted automatic route for this record; not evidence that the source lacks information.
definitions.url: Distinct primary canonical URL, separate from URL+identity routing cohorts.
definitions.replay: Cached integration replay, 13826 records, not the published DEV release or a completed crawl.
definitions.reason_caution: Record failures overlap. Counts below are disjoint because this explicit precedence chooses one primary cause.

resolver.explanation: Only original town URLs with already valid generic identity, municipality/province/region and full simple weekday are eligible; missing province resource or non-exact town slug remains to prove. It does not read all unrouted identities.

geography_903.caution: A municipality mismatch includes ward/venue labels, historical names, spelling differences and true errors; do not label every mismatch an incorrect municipality or auto-map from lexical similarity.

captured_source_review.candidate_not_write_proof: One source row for a city can motivate a whole-cohort identity recovery rule, but these rows lack an independent exact stored venue. No weekday, date or address was assigned.

Some explicitly require correct holds for genuinely ambiguous or incomplete source data; such negative acceptance cases do not make the whole ticket unimplementable or complete. Source inaccessibility has one dedicated retry ticket. This classification is a review of ledger scope, not 36 newly fetched sources.
